description: Read-only. The workspace's webhooks: id, receiver site (the host only: receiver URLs often carry a secret), the events each one gets (link.clicked, app.opened, install.matched, app.event, referral.converted) and whether it is on. Never returns signing secrets. Use the id with list_webhook_deliveries or test_webhook. Webhooks are added in Dashboard → Settings → Webhooks.
name: list_webhooks
title: List webhooks
